$comment: Two layers, read by `pnpm prod:list-values`. `minimum`: the presentation floor — the list builder shows 20 values before search, so a list below it is shallow. Floors (`default`, `groups`, `lists`): the catalog depth target that `gap` measures. Floor precedence: --floor N, then lists[slug], then groups[slug], then default. Keys are Category slugs (lists) and CategoryGroup slugs (groups). Compatibility, lifestyle, money, home, career and travel lists use the default 30; entertainment and taste domains 40; broad canonical lists 50. A list whose domain honestly can't reach its floor gets its own lower entry here rather than padded values.
